expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: DocumentTable component with hooks, table rendering, DeleteConfirmModal, complete implementation

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Full DocumentTable component with state management and JSX

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Delete uses only type-to-confirm dialog. Archive has grace-period undo via setUndoToast, but delete (the destructive action) has no recovery mechanism

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: {selectedCount} selected' shown in bulk action bar, and 'Delete {count} documents?' in modal

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: isAllVisibleSelected and isAllMatchingSelected tracked separately; 'Select all {totalCount} matching documents' button shown conditionally

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive is gray/white bordered button; Delete is red text on white with red border. Visually distinct.

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: DeleteConfirmModal has autoFocus on input field, not the delete button

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Code includes idempotency keys but does not note server-side enforcement requirements

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Response closes with 'Per your instructions, the above component is complete and designed under the Poka-Yoke interface paradigms.' Misuses are listed in preamble, not at close.
